The conversion is not valid for every network. In stochastic networks, dynamic port-efficiency data can have MultiIndex columns for scenarios and component names, but `_model_snapshot_array` treats all columns as a single `"name"` dimension and calls `values.columns.rename("name")`, which is invalid for a MultiIndex. Thus transmission cannot reliably apply efficiency and weighting at the flow’s snapshot labels for these networks.
